            FontStyle,
            FontVariant,
            FontWeight,
            Direction,
            LetterSpacing,

            Tspan,
            Tref,
            TextPath,
            StartOffset,
            Method,
            Spacing,
            StdDeviation,
            TextAlign,
            PathLength,
            Type,
